claim_scope_notes.P3: The report explicitly marks P3 failed and reproduces hop alive 1..7,9,11, then dead 12..64, so the registered finite prediction failure is honestly disclosed. An all-depth no-counting/death claim is not established by this finite prefix.
claim_scope_notes.additive_algebra: After x_i := main_i XOR R, all four additive rules have zero exterior and three free initial bits. Rule60 is W XOR (W<<1); rule90 is (W<<1) XOR (W>>1); rule150 adds W; rule102 is W XOR (W>>1). The length is t+3, and terminal NAE forbids000 and111 among all consecutive triples. The formulas, not a generic CA picture, specify the exact tested depth predicate.
claim_scope_notes.extension_evidence_class: Finite exact computation beyond the preregistered horizon, clearly separated; not a proof of all-depth behavior or a new registered result.
claim_scope_notes.rule102: The zero-exterior recurrence gives one more zero at the right on each update, so at t>=3 the last three relative bits are all zero and terminal NAE fails. This elementary induction extends its observed death beyond64; no analogous proof is supplied here for hop.
claim_scope_notes.rules90_150: Exact finite sequences match, and the packed-word recurrences supply an exact uniform depth predicate for this one-sided boundary and terminal closure. Dependence on binary depth in additive automata alone is not a proof that this closure's satisfiability sequence is nonperiodic. The registered observation is unexplained within 64 (no period<=16 with onset<=32). A theorem for that exact predicate or a directly applicable cited theorem is needed for the stronger phrase count too.

minimality_implications: For a proven minimum f3 gadget with 12 constraints, deleting one cannot preserve the exact parity; otherwise a smaller gadget would exist.
A parity-preserving replacement has 12 constraints and is therefore another minimum f3 gadget.
Minimality alone does not determine which replacements preserve parity, or whether other projected relations have nonperiodic alive sequences.
mutant_summary.scope: The 169 constant and 68 eventually constant labels describe the tested 1..64 prefix under the registered classifier. They are not all-depth theorems; nor is unexplained proof of counting.

parity_controls.collision_justification: Each collided slot gets a fresh distinct copy; equality is two strict-NAE inequalities. Full primitive truth tables verified. Every gadget uses disjoint helpers. Hence local existential elimination commutes with conjunction for all tested depths.
parity_controls.source_lifetime: All initial variables and R are existential open choices; no executor supplies values.
parity_controls.verification_boundary: Depths 1..64: exact full-system quantified elimination from independently exhausted local gadget/copy relations plus exhaustive 16-seed propagation. Depths 1..8: additional whole-system SAT for direct clauses and strict NAE gadgets. At depth64 the whole strict NAE formula is rebuilt and checked for distinct variables in every triple; it is not submitted to whole-system SAT.

provenance.independent_code: No import or call of census.py; independently implemented Boolean enumeration, GF(2), and SAT CNF.
